title: After explicitly resolving 'The Wood Question' in favor of preserving the Kingswood ('keep the rides exactly as they are', Barrow-Keepers +2, Crown -2), a later pass by the Marked Oak reads 'A vast oak, chalked for felling -- again,' which on first read looks like the felling threat returned despite my decision (it's defensible as yearly re-marking per an earlier room's 'decades of marks never yet acted on,' but the wording invites the opposite reading).
